item.tib: lha mo nag mo'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa
item.note: The middle part of this text is identical with rKTs1090 / D1090, but at the beginning and end, this work is entirely different. Though similar in name, it is not the same as rKTs666. This text here is similar to F571, but the version in F is significantly shorter. This work seems to be found only in Sutra collections.
